outcome.interpretation: The live ECI readback exposes one successful, correlated CLI request in the selected event window. The current session declared no readiness-service scope, so ambient fulfillment, agent receipt, and intervention burden remain unmeasured.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session capability evidence does not identify the Environment CLI request surface
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment capability invocation and ECI session activity
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The pre-change invocation and completion records did not carry a request-surface field; historical CLI route activity was not recorded.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: Not established; one post-change CLI interaction is visible in this bounded window.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep explicit request-surface evidence correlated to invocation and completion while preserving unknown actor, ambient need, and burden.
not_measured: whether the request replaced or followed an ambient service opportunity
whether the recorded caller was an agent and which runtime it used
service fulfillment ratio or reduction in agent intervention
